changelog: Public CDR responses now preserve measured zero values for setup time, PDD, SIP disposition code, MOS, jitter, packet loss and SIP message count instead of conv
This keeps API v1, Call Insight responses, exports and downstream integrations from treating valid zero metrics as missing data.
changelog_es: The portal/API CDR projection now preserves valid numeric zero values for setup time, PDD, SIP disposition code, MOS, jitter, packet loss and SIP message count
This keeps `/api/v1/cdrs`, `/api/v1/calls/:id/insights`, exports and downstream integrations from treating measured zero values as missing data.
